pairs.contract: The endpoints implement different layout responsibilities.
pairs.rationale: Padding extends one content line to a measured width; border construction creates the top and bottom frame strings.
pairs.difference_witness: Padding preserves line text and adds spaces, while make_borders returns underscore and dash borders unrelated to line content.

pairs.contract: The endpoints implement different layout responsibilities.
pairs.rationale: Line padding computes trailing spaces; thought-border construction creates framing glyph runs.
pairs.difference_witness: A Unicode content line is returned padded by pad_line, whereas make_borders ignores content and returns two frame strings.

pairs.contract: A low-level spacing helper and complete thought-bubble renderer are separate responsibilities.
pairs.rationale: pad_line is one helper used during framing; render_bubble builds borders, side glyphs, and joins every line.
pairs.difference_witness: pad_line returns one unframed line; render_bubble returns a multiline thought bubble.

pairs.contract: A formatting helper and process entry point are separate responsibilities.
pairs.rationale: Padding manipulates one string; main handles process output, diagnostics, and exit status around CLI execution.
pairs.difference_witness: main can terminate with status 2 after printing usage; pad_line cannot perform process control.

pairs.contract: Mode dispatch and one complete rendering implementation are separate maintenance responsibilities.
pairs.rationale: bubble::render measures width and selects a mode; the speech renderer implements frame construction for one already selected mode.
pairs.difference_witness: The dispatcher can produce thought output; speech::render_bubble always produces speech framing.

pairs.contract: Mode dispatch and one complete rendering implementation are separate maintenance responsibilities.
pairs.rationale: bubble::render measures width and selects a mode; the thought renderer implements only thought framing.
pairs.difference_witness: The dispatcher can produce speech output; thought::render_bubble always produces thought framing.

pairs.contract: Adjacent rendering layers retain different orchestration boundaries.
pairs.rationale: bubble::render accepts wrapped lines and frames them; lib::render clamps options, wraps a message, adds cow artwork, and assembles final output.
pairs.difference_witness: bubble::render never wraps text or appends a cow; lib::render always coordinates those stages.

pairs.contract: Application help and message layout are separate responsibilities.
pairs.rationale: Bubble dispatch frames content; print_usage emits fixed CLI help to stderr.
pairs.difference_witness: print_usage has no message input and emits options text; bubble::render returns a framed message.

pairs.contract: Width measurement and bubble assembly are separate responsibilities.
pairs.rationale: display_width counts Unicode scalar values for one string; bubble::render calls it while computing the maximum and then delegates framing.
pairs.difference_witness: display_width returns an integer; bubble::render returns a multiline string.

pairs.contract: Border construction and complete bubble rendering are separate responsibilities.
pairs.rationale: make_borders creates only horizontal frame strings; render_bubble adds side glyphs, padding, and line-specific corners.
pairs.difference_witness: make_borders returns a two-string tuple; render_bubble returns the full multiline bubble.

pairs.contract: A speech-border helper and thought renderer have different behavior contracts.
pairs.rationale: The helper returns horizontal borders only; the renderer builds complete thought-mode rows using parentheses.
pairs.difference_witness: The border helper cannot emit thought side glyphs or content rows.

pairs.contract: Message framing and cow artwork are separate responsibilities.
pairs.rationale: Border construction depends on bubble width; cow::render selects a connector and returns fixed animal artwork.
pairs.difference_witness: Changing width changes borders but never changes the cow artwork body.

pairs.contract: Layout construction and default option creation are separate responsibilities.
pairs.rationale: make_borders formats glyph runs from a width; CowOptions::default returns a fixed configuration value.
pairs.difference_witness: The default constructor returns width, mode, and algorithm fields; make_borders returns two strings.

pairs.contract: CLI handling and border construction are separate responsibilities.
pairs.rationale: main::run parses arguments and input before calling the public renderer; make_borders only formats a supplied width.
pairs.difference_witness: An unknown wrapper makes run return an error before layout; make_borders has no option parsing.

pairs.contract: A complete speech renderer and thought-border helper have different behavior contracts.
pairs.rationale: The speech renderer produces content rows and corners; the thought helper returns only horizontal borders.
pairs.difference_witness: speech::render_bubble contains message text and slash sides; thought::make_borders returns no content rows.

pairs.contract: Rendering and default option creation are separate responsibilities.
pairs.rationale: The renderer builds a bubble from lines and width; the default constructor returns constant API options.
pairs.difference_witness: The renderer returns text; the constructor returns CowOptions.

pairs.contract: Message rendering and CLI help are separate responsibilities.
pairs.rationale: Speech rendering formats arbitrary lines; print_usage emits a fixed help document.
pairs.difference_witness: Help text lists flags on stderr; speech rendering returns the supplied message inside a frame.

pairs.contract: Border construction and complete bubble rendering are separate responsibilities.
pairs.rationale: make_borders creates two frame strings; render_bubble owns content rows, padding, parentheses, and joining.
pairs.difference_witness: The helper returns a tuple without content; the renderer returns the complete thought bubble.

pairs.contract: Layout construction and default option creation are separate responsibilities.
pairs.rationale: Thought borders depend on measured width; default options are fixed API configuration.
pairs.difference_witness: One returns frame strings and the other returns CowOptions.

pairs.contract: Layout construction and package metadata exposure are separate responsibilities.
pairs.rationale: Border construction formats width-dependent glyphs; fixture_version returns the package version string.
pairs.difference_witness: fixture_version ignores width and message content; make_borders requires a width.

pairs.contract: A mode-specific renderer and whole-application rendering pipeline are separate responsibilities.
pairs.rationale: Thought rendering frames prewrapped lines; lib::render clamps width, wraps raw text, selects a bubble mode, and appends cow artwork.
pairs.difference_witness: lib::render can produce speech and always appends a cow; thought::render_bubble does neither.

pairs.contract: A mode-specific renderer and process entry point are separate responsibilities.
pairs.rationale: Thought rendering is a pure layout function; main prints output or errors and controls process exit.
pairs.difference_witness: main may exit with an error before rendering; thought::render_bubble has no process side effects.

pairs.contract: Animal artwork and message wrapping are separate responsibilities.
pairs.rationale: cow::render chooses a connector in fixed artwork; scanner wrapping tokenizes paragraphs and lays out bounded lines.
pairs.difference_witness: Wrapping changes with message and width; cow artwork changes only its connector mode.

pairs.contract: Animal artwork and long-word splitting are separate responsibilities.
pairs.rationale: cow::render produces fixed multiline art; split_word divides arbitrary Unicode text at width boundaries.
pairs.difference_witness: split_word returns text pieces preserving input characters; cow::render returns unrelated artwork.

pairs.contract: Animal artwork and wrapping dispatch are separate responsibilities.
pairs.rationale: cow::render formats the animal connector; wrapping::wrap selects one of two message-layout implementations.
pairs.difference_witness: wrapping::wrap returns message lines and accepts an algorithm; cow::render returns one artwork string.

pairs.contract: Default option construction and the browser-facing rendering adapter are separate responsibilities.
pairs.rationale: CowOptions::default provides constant native defaults; cowsay converts WebAssembly-friendly arguments and renders output.
pairs.difference_witness: The constructor returns options without rendering; cowsay returns a complete cowsay string.

pairs.contract: A public adapter and internal long-word helper are separate responsibilities.
pairs.rationale: cowsay maps public arguments into options and invokes full rendering; split_word only divides one word.
pairs.difference_witness: cowsay returns framed text and artwork; split_word returns a vector of word pieces.

pairs.contract: A public adapter and internal wrapping dispatcher are separate responsibilities.
pairs.rationale: cowsay translates public arguments and returns final rendered output; wrapping::wrap selects a line-breaking implementation.
pairs.difference_witness: wrapping::wrap returns unframed lines; cowsay returns the bubble plus cow.

pairs.contract: Package metadata exposure and native CLI execution are separate responsibilities.
pairs.rationale: fixture_version returns compile-time metadata; run parses arguments or stdin and invokes rendering.
pairs.difference_witness: fixture_version cannot reject CLI options or read stdin; run can.

pairs.contract: Pure rendering orchestration and process control are separate responsibilities.
pairs.rationale: lib::render returns formatted content from explicit inputs; main handles printing, diagnostics, usage, and exit status.
pairs.difference_witness: main can print an error and exit 2 without a rendered string; lib::render has no process control.

pairs.contract: Library rendering and native CLI parsing are separate responsibilities.
pairs.rationale: lib::render performs the text-rendering pipeline from typed options; main::run parses argv/stdin and translates failures before delegating.
pairs.difference_witness: An invalid --wrapper returns Err from run without calling render; lib::render accepts only a valid WrapAlgorithm.

pairs.contract: Whole-output rendering and wrapping dispatch are separate responsibilities.
pairs.rationale: lib::render clamps options, frames lines, and appends artwork; wrapping::wrap only selects a line-breaking algorithm.
pairs.difference_witness: The wrapping dispatcher returns Vec<String>; lib::render returns one complete multiline String.

pairs.contract: Paragraph wrapping and long-word splitting are separate responsibilities.
pairs.rationale: The fold implementation manages whitespace, paragraphs, and line accumulation; split_word is a shared boundary helper for one oversized token.
pairs.difference_witness: Wrapping an ordinary sentence produces multiple word-aware lines without calling split behavior for every word; split_word knows no paragraph boundaries.

pairs.contract: Paragraph wrapping and long-word splitting are separate responsibilities.
pairs.rationale: The scanner implementation controls paragraph and current-line state; split_word only chunks one oversized Unicode word.
pairs.difference_witness: scanner::wrap preserves paragraph breaks and word spacing; split_word receives neither paragraphs nor whitespace context.
